title: New starter induction
description: A short welcome for someone new: who to ask, who to tell if you are worried about a child, and the first things to find out.

questions.prompt: You are worried about a child. Who do you tell?

options.text: The designated safeguarding lead, straight away
Wait for the next staff meeting

questions.explanation: Tell the designated safeguarding lead straight away. Do not wait and do not deal with it alone.

learnMore.title: EYFS statutory framework for group and school-based providers

questions.prompt: Someone you do not know asks to collect a child. What do you do?

options.text: Hand the child over if they seem friendly
Do not hand the child over and ask your manager
Ask the child if they know them
Let them wait in the room with the child

questions.explanation: Never hand a child to someone you do not know. Ask your manager.

learnMore.title: EYFS statutory framework for group and school-based providers

questions.prompt: If you are not sure what to do in your first week, it is better to ask. True or false?
questions.explanation: True. Nobody expects you to know everything at once. Ask your manager or a colleague.

learnMore.title: EYFS statutory framework for group and school-based providers

questions.prompt: You do not need to read the setting's policies in your first days. True or false?
questions.explanation: False. The policies tell you what to do and what not to do, so ask to see them early.

learnMore.title: EYFS statutory framework for group and school-based providers

questions.prompt: What should you find out on your first day?

options.text: Where the fire exits and the assembly point are
Which snacks are the most popular

questions.explanation: Find out where the fire exits and the assembly point are, and what to do when the alarm sounds.

learnMore.title: EYFS statutory framework for group and school-based providers

questions.prompt: You should know where the first aid kit is. True or false?
questions.explanation: True. Look for the first aid kit and the names of the trained first aiders.

learnMore.title: EYFS statutory framework for group and school-based providers
